svg.title: Private layer readiness precedes the public request commit
svg.desc: One request owns its token history, table version, credits and forward-operation identity
svg.text: Private layer readiness precedes the public request commit
One request owns its token history, table version, credits and forward-operation identity
Prepare the forward: new logical range and candidate mappings
Prefill inputs are the prompt; decode input is the one pending selected ID.
Reserve/assign capacity before submission; globally published N is still unchanged.
For each layer: complete new state, then consume old plus current
This forward’s private descriptor may read that layer’s ready candidate rows.
Apply the correct mask and architecture; unrelated consumers cannot read a partial prefix.
After all layers and logits complete: commit the cache version
Validate request/attempt/step/epoch and cancellation state under the authority.
Only then may the generator commit one selection from the associated logit row.
Check stopping before scheduling the next forward
A nonterminal selection becomes pending input; a terminal selection ends generation.
Duplicate/late completions never repeat append, selection or resource release.
Waiting for all layers before current-layer attention would create a dependency cycle; use scoped readiness.
